parsed.main_gap: The constructive half of the refinement lemma omits the justification that the overlay produces paired pieces using at most q−1 cuts.

errors.description: The crucial overlay construction and its cut count are merely asserted. One must count the foreign row boundaries and the possible A-tail boundary, then add one bisection per outside interval. This is a localized, straightforward gap, but it underpins Xiang’s upper bound.
errors.quote: and use at most \(q-1\) cuts in total (standard; details omitted).

parsed.notes: Apart from this omission, the drafting lemma, graph lower bound, subset-sum bound, and binary construction form a coherent and apparently correct proof.
